# Furniture assets

- **Windsor chair and Shaker nightstand:** visible-surface game adaptations of
  [ShopPrentice](https://github.com/ShopPrentice/shopprentice), revision
  `d670906ae258a80eefe9ec65d5cccffe67d2f1fb`, under MIT. The original notice is
  in `ShopPrentice-MIT.txt`. The editable generator is
  `Browser/build-furniture-designs.mjs`; original Fusion scripts and reference
  images are retained in `Research/room-furnishings/sources/shopprentice/`.
- **Panca_50 bench:** the six-solid STEP assembly from
  [Compagnia d'arme del Santo Luca](https://github.com/Compagnia-d-Arme-del-Santo-Luca/medieval_furniture),
  revision `081fd0bc28486aff01fa4dde2d64227809a7ac01`, converted from millimetres
  to metres and Z-up to Y-up, under GPL-3.0. Original licence:
  `Panca-GPL-3.0.txt`. **Corresponding editable source**, converter and licence
  are distributed together in [panca-source.zip](panca-source.zip).
- **Bed, shelves, table and books:** Kay Lousberg's KayKit Furniture Bits 1.0,
  revision `96d5930a8dbdb363409bbc2d3341718b00e17c9c`, under CC0. See `LICENSE.txt`.

`manifest.json` verifies the original KayKit files. `design-manifest.json`
verifies the generated designs and accompanying licence/source files.
Runtime dimensions and bookcase/medical-case assembly are documented in
`Research/room-furnishings/README.md`.
